sources.note: Nordic Africa Institute programme page stating the round is closed

awarding_body.detail: The source URL resolves to the Nordic Africa Institute (nai.uu.se, Uppsala), which runs the programme itself. Official.
awarding_body.quote: Nordic Scholarship Programme - The Nordic Africa Institute

deadline.detail: The record carries "Closing date 11 October 2026" (exact, 2026-10-11). The page does not print a numeric deadline; it states the round is closed, which is consistent with a deadline that has just passed, but the exact date cannot be read from the page. The record itself was last verified 2026-10-11.
deadline.quote: Closed for applications ** The deadline to apply for the 2027 programme has passed.

eligibility.detail: Africa-oriented studies/research in the social sciences or humanities; any citizenship but affiliation to and based at a university or research centre in Sweden, Finland, Denmark or Iceland both at application and at the time of the stay; master students, PhD candidates, postdocs and mid-career researchers. The record matches.
eligibility.quote: You must be pursuing Africa-oriented studies/research within the fields of social sciences or humanities. You may apply regardless of citizenship, but you must be affiliated to and based at a university or research centre in Sweden, Finland, Denmark or Iceland.

funding.detail: Travel for the least expensive fare, accommodation, a workspace, and a subsistence allowance of SEK 450 per day. That is a travel/subsistence award, not a fully funded scholarship in the sense of tuition and living costs for a degree.
funding.quote: The scholarship also includes a subsistence allowance of SEK 450 per day. The scholarship does not include health care insurance or other insurances.

degree_levels.detail: The page accepts master students, PhD candidates, postdoctoral and mid-career researchers, so Master and PhD are correct — but the award funds a one-month research visit, not a degree.
degree_levels.quote: You can be a master student, PhD candidate, postdoctoral or mid-career researcher.

recommended_field_updates.deadline_text: Closed for applications: the deadline for the 2027 programme has passed
recommended_field_updates.verification_notes: Verified live on nai.uu.se on 2026-10-12. The 2027 round closed (deadline had passed at the time of checking); the next cycle's dates are not published. Outcomes "by the end of November 2026 the latest". The award is a one-month research-visit scholarship (travel, accommodation, SEK 450/day allowance) - it is not a fully funded degree scholarship, so the funding_type "Fully Funded" overstates it.

notes_for_reviewer: Two things a reviewer must decide: the funding label ("Fully Funded" is wrong for a one-month visit award that covers travel, accommodation and a SEK 450/day allowance) and the lifecycle (the round has closed; the next window is unpublished).
